units.function: Static manifest feature and worker-to-host operation capability checker using a central string-to-string requirement map, UI/launcher maps and fail-closed unknown-operation behavior.
units.dependencyDirection: Depends on shared manifest/capability/UI types plus server errors/logger; Loader calls install consistency checks and host bridges are expected to call runtime assertions.
units.keyDataModels: PluginCapability strings, operation names, manifest-declared capability set and allowed/missing check result.
units.lifecycle: Checks feature declarations at install, tests declared strings on each operation, rejects unknown operations or missing capabilities and reports human-readable denial messages.
units.testAssessment: Six environment/external-object seam cases passed. They cover selected schema refinements and operation mappings but not exhaustive map/schema/handler parity, excessive grants, unknown-operation API ambiguity, upgrade/removal, scoped grants or denial evidence.
units.designRationale: Make plugin least-privilege intent declarative and centrally auditable while rejecting new host operations until explicitly mapped.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs declared Connector capabilities separated from administrator-approved grants and runtime leases, all narrowed by organization, resource, data purpose/destination, risk, time and Responsibility contract.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE the central fail-closed operation registry and feature-consistency tests. Rebuild as CapabilityDeclaration plus ApprovedGrant plus short-lived InvocationAuthority, generate map parity tests from one contract source and emit stable decision codes/evidence.
units.responsibilityConflict: A manifest string is treated as authority; one environment capability grants the full lifecycle and raw provider-key access. There is no accountable approver, exact package digest, company/resource scope, high-risk action binding, purpose, expiry or evidence chain.

units.function: Cross-layer contract tests for environment-driver and external-object manifest declarations, selected capability gates and worker SDK hook dispatch.
units.dependencyDirection: Uses shared schema, server capability validator and plugin SDK protocol/worker host in memory with streams.
units.keyDataModels: Environment driver, lease/setup responses, external object provider/detection/snapshot, companyId and JSON-RPC success/error envelopes.
units.lifecycle: Validates manifests, checks operation requirements, initializes an in-process worker host, dispatches hooks and verifies supported or unimplemented responses.
units.testAssessment: All six cases passed quickly. Coverage is a useful vertical seam but omits authenticated company scope, exhaustive capability parity, execution/cancel/timeout/idempotency, SSRF, egress, malformed payloads and responsibility evidence.
units.designRationale: Keep schema, server authorization vocabulary and SDK runtime hooks synchronized for two plugin extension families.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs this style of compatibility test across Connector SDK, API and runtime, expanded to governed authority and evidence semantics.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the vertical seam and METHOD_NOT_IMPLEMENTED contract; generate exhaustive operation-capability cases and add identity/tenant mismatch, digest-bound grant, risk approval, timeout/cancel, attestation and data-egress tests.
units.responsibilityConflict: Worker requests supply companyId as ordinary input and no authenticated principal, accountable human, approval, permission lease or execution evidence is checked.
